name: game-design-review
description: > Reviews an existing GDD or feature spec with a severity-rated rubric: pillar alignment, MDA and player-psychology fit, consistency, scope, testability for agent-built games, originality, AI disclosure and accessibility hooks, ending in a build-readiness verdict. Use for "review my GDD", "design feedback", "critique this spec". Not for writing a GDD (use game-gdd-author).
author: AlterLab-IEU
